title: Enterprise AI Assistant

hero.headline: Secure AI for internal knowledge and workflow support.
hero.description: A practical assistant for document reasoning, search, and task support inside an organization.

problem: Teams lose time navigating documents, policies, and repetitive internal tasks.
solution: Provide a focused assistant that can answer questions, surface relevant sources, and support approved workflows.
proofNotes: This product should be backed by retrieval quality, response reliability, and clear evaluation criteria before broad release.
